territories.name: Tonga
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Tonga levies a consumption tax of its own under the Consumption Tax Act 2003: the Ministry of Revenue and Customs administers it at a rate of 15 per cent, exports and the other supplies of the Orders made under section 5(3)(a) are zero-rated, health, education, financial services, public transport and residential land leases are exempt, and a registered person files a return, form CT206, for each month within 28 days after its end.
